mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread telling BMW owners to inspect every King set before installing, after a factory box labelled standard was found to contain oversized 0.25 bearings mixed in. Packaging/QC complaint rather than a material failure, but the title itself is a warning to buyers.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread claiming King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 are out of spec, slipping onto the main cap and block side groove too easily instead of being an interference fit, with a stated risk of spinning the thrust main. Still open and unanswered by King.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is---King Bearings are no longer an option....
mentions.snippet: Thread title is a flat verdict that King is no longer a viable choice for DSM builds. Reads as one builder's conclusion rather than a documented defect report, and the thread has never been readable from here to see whether others agreed.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Single buyer reporting a defective shell in a King SI set, with related reports in the same search of malformed SI shells crushed or twisted in production and machining shavings left on rod bearings. Credible single-unit QC complaint.

mentions.title: king Main&Rod Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Opens as a brand question but carries a serious claim in the replies: a mechanic reporting that every Honda engine he built on King bearings destroyed its crank journals within a few thousand miles. Crank damage is the costly end of a bearing complaint.

mentions.title: Kings Engine Bearings.... anybody have problems??
mentions.snippet: Problem-solicitation thread asking the racing community to report King failures, which draws complaints rather than answering a technical question. Associated reports include inconsistent thickness, excessive crush and dents on the backs of shells.
